AI Firm Anthropic Explores IPO Amidst Major Investments and Infrastructure Deals

Artificial intelligence company Anthropic, founded in 2021 by former OpenAI employees, is reportedly exploring an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The company has secured significant backing from major investors including Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, and Nvidia. Recent reports indicate Anthropic's IPO roadshow is seeking a valuation of $64.35 billion, with some sources suggesting a valuation of nearly $70 billion. In parallel, Anthropic has inked a $3.4 billion deal for gas-powered data centers to support its AI development ahead of the potential IPO. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) is also investing up to $1 billion in Anthropic. The company's potential IPO could see approximately 5,300 employees become millionaires.
